description: This file defines the main UI components and entry point for a Tic Tac Toe game implemented with Jetpack Compose. It includes the MainActivity class, composable functions for rendering the game screen, board, cells, status indicators, and reset button, as well as interactions between these components. The file manages the game state through a ViewModel and provides a complete user interface for gameplay, including animations and styling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity launching the game, setting up theme and content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets edge-to-edge display, and sets the content view with the game UI.

methods.name: GameScreen
methods.description: Composable function rendering the main game UI components including background, player indicator, board, result, and reset button.

methods.name: PlayerIndicator
methods.description: Displays current player or game result status.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Displays the 3x3 grid of game cells with animations and tap interactions.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Displays X or O within a grid cell with animation effects.

methods.name: ResultBar
methods.description: Shows game status messages with fade animation.

methods.name: ResetButton
methods.description: Button to reset the game board.
